notes.title: Patch v1.0.71 out now
notes.content:
[u][b]Content Update:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Bouncy Bubbles course hole order changed
[*] Cafe Latte : New Hole 5 to replace the old super difficult Hole 5.  The old hole design will reappear in future updates in the "Hall of Rage" course.

[/list]

[u][b]Bugs Fixed / Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Improved Laser pointers (for Vive and WMR) to interact more cleanly with the menu and avoid collision or interaction with scene objects.  Also fixed a bug causing VR chaperone/guardian to block/interfere with laser pointers.
[*] Huge improvement to the Menu/Interface when displayed in tight spaces or in places where it could be blocked by environment or random objects, menu will cause objects touching it or in the line of view of player to become see through.
[*] Cafe Latte course got updated geometries for Holes 6, 7, 8, and 9.  This should fix issues with ball sometimes getting stuck or drifting endlessly.
[*] Pirate Bay Hole 8 got updated geometry. This should fix issues with ball sometimes getting stuck or drifting endlessly on this hole as well.
[*] Arcadia MMXX Course - Hole #8 fixed paddle so it doesnt go through the wall.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.70 out now
notes.content:
[u][b]Content Update:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Bouncy Bubbles course updated: added glowing rims to all the cutouts in the bubble domes, to improve visibility of these holes 
[/list]

[u][b]Bugs Fixed / Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing game to fail to start after "Change Course" is selected from "Choose Ball and Putter" menu
[*] Added a delay on putter collision after a player moves on to the next turn, to avoid accidental ball hit immediately after teleport. 
[*] Fixed pause menu to show the correct Course name and photo
[*] Improved menu-pointer interaction for Vive and WMR, to avoid unintentional selections and double clicks
[*] Arcadia MMXX Course - Hole #8 fixed bad collider causing player to "pop up" when close to the paddle
[*] Pirate Bay - Hole #4:  redesigned part of this Hole so avoid the ball could getting stuck in the corner
[/list]
